text.offer: Quintor says, "Ants were one thing. Now the trolls are coming down out of the Cragged Mountains, and a troll will eat a miner whole. Kill eight of them, and I'll make it worth your while."
text.progress: Quintor says, "The trolls roam the high slopes of the Cragged Mountains, near Jasper. Don't let them corner you."
text.complete: Quintor says, "Eight trolls. You're tougher than you look. Here's your pay."

steps.objective: Trolls slain in the Cragged Mountains
